stage: One stationary white-IMU noise calibration frozen before original/held-out evaluation; geometric observation ablations; production defaults unchanged

calibration.method: Adjacent-difference covariance / 2, averaged over each sensor's three axes; continuous spectral density is sample variance times sample period.
calibration.limitations: The caller declares physical rest. Assumes independent white sample noise; does not estimate bias, bias random walk, vibration spectra, colored noise or temperature drift. Not an automatic stationary detector or flight tuning recommendation.

native_noise_unit_audit.native_formula: PX4 generated prediction and EKF3 source use rate variance times prediction dt squared. ESKF ProcessNoise is continuous PSD and its integral uses PSD times dt. Equal printed numerical settings do not imply equal process uncertainty.
native_noise_unit_audit.scope: Actual native generated PX4 covariance helper exercised at 5/10/20 ms; EKF3 formula/defaults inspected in pinned source, not isolated native AP execution. Illustration uses 10 ms and is not a claim that all native actual prediction intervals equal 10 ms. No native tuning or cores changed.

ranking.note: Three-seed medians; 36 dataset/rate/delay/scenario aggregates. GPS/denied flight, transition outage window. Strictly smaller error; no uncertainty/significance claim or all-seed superiority. Native configurations unchanged.

native_reuse: Same 216 native runs and configurations from native-delay stage. All new ESKF delivery counts/digests match native traces. Native tuning has not been calibrated to the new ESKF densities; configured-stack comparison only.
scope: White-sample noise identification in declared rest, not flight sensor identification, bias drift estimation or robustness under magnetic/range/vibration faults. No Modelica algorithm/default changes; scalar heading regressions retained. Horizon covariance and target efficiency qualification remain missing.
composed_horizon_boundary: Unresolved recorded Rumoca ED020 at HorizonEstimator.mo:259:5, identity 578 not owned by clock 0. Benchmark explicitly schedules unchanged generated components.
remaining_goal: Better horizontal medians in all 36 aggregates is not all-metric/all-seed superiority. Five all-four-metric aggregate wins, ten horizontal seed exceptions, remaining vertical/velocity/yaw and output-smoothness gaps. Calibration should next be applied consistently to native parameter conventions.
storage: Existing captures read from $HOME/scratch; bounded owned probes in temporary storage because scratch and .git are read-only; compiler caches disabled.
